title: AI May Widen Global Inequality
discussion_signal: The post interprets the report through three channels—people, economy, and governance—and highlights dependence on foreign cloud and models, uneven state capability, and pilots that cannot scale independently. It also preserves a counter-signal: AI may narrow gaps when applied to health, education, climate, and multilingual or remote contexts with locally appropriate pathways.
linked_research_question: When AI capability is geographically concentrated, which dependencies widen divergence and which locally grounded uses create convergence?
limits: Professional summary rather than independent replication
Examples of opportunity are prospective rather than measured effects
LinkedIn engagement is not a representative development debate
